topics.name: Mobile plant pre-starts
topics.description: Pre-start and pre-operational checks of mobile plant (loaders, haul trucks, excavators, dozers), defect reporting and taking unsafe plant out of service.

inspection and testing of guards and isolation points

supervision of contractors and verifying competency
contractor safe work method statements and risk assessments
